$doc: Top-level run and session rules. See docs/CONFIG.md.

lobby.$doc: The pre-run cabin. A solo player starts the moment they press E on a poster; in multiplayer the first vote opens a countdown, which shortens to `allReadyStartSeconds` once everyone has voted.
lobby.$note: `posterSlots` is how many frames the poster wall has, not how many maps exist. Slots past the enabled map list hang blank white posters.

scoring.$doc: The post-run scoreboard. Rows are these categories in this order, and the best value in each gets the green ring - but only when there is more than one player to be better than. `id` must be one of the counters logic keeps (src/world/runStats.ts); a category naming anything else reads as zero.
scoring.$note: `noiseMade` is the one where LESS is better, and it is loudness accumulated rather than a count of sounds - a run measured in footstep events would call a sprinter and a crouching player equally loud.
